messages:
Rae (Design): dropped a short mock + notes for the batch rerank + vectors preview. Questions: should we let users pin columns (so they always export them), how to surface export size estimate, and small a11y tweaks for colorblind contrast on relevance heatmap. gif: https://rwd-assets/pin-export.gif

Ike (Eng): pinning columns sounds fine. Implementation: store exportColumnPresets separate from previewColumnState. Pins should persist per workspace.

Maya (PM): agree. UX: default export preset should include pinned columns first. If user changes preview ordering, pinned exports should still be first unless they explicitly reorder in export modal.

Rae (Design): copy thought: export modal header = "Export vectors ilters, rerank & columns included" and a small inline estimate "~2.3 MB (500 rows)" computed client-side. If estimate >50MB show background job warning.

Sam (Accessibility): a11y notes: relevance heatmap uses red->green which is bad for red/green colorblind users. Suggest a diverging palette + texture or pattern for the cell backgrounds and include numeric labels. Also add aria-label for each heatmap cell like "relevance 0.87".

Ike (Eng): for patterns we can add a subtle diagonal hatch on low/high extremes. Numeric labels should be visible on hover for dense tables.

Maya (PM): Export UX question: CSV vs JSONL vs streaming. Propose: small exports (<10k rows) offer immediate download; mid-size (10k-100k) offer streaming CSV; >100k require background job with email + channel notification. Add a checkbox in modal: "Include checksum (SHA256)" for integrity verification.

Rae (Design): love the checksum idea. UI: show it as a small toggle in advanced options with tooltip "Enable file checksum for verifying download integrity."

Sam (Accessibility): keyboard focus: when modal opens move focus to first input (preset name), trap focus, and ensure Esc closes. For the pinned column controls, make them accessible as a listbox with aria-multiselectable so keyboard users can reorder and toggle pins.

Ike (Eng): implementation notes: export service will accept columns[], export_format, checksum boolean, and model_id. We'll compute estimate for row size client-side using sampled row serialization. For streaming, generate a chunked response; for background jobs write to S3 and send presigned URL.

OpsBot: Export job policy updated: concurrent background exports per org = 3. Excess requests will be queued.

Maya (PM): acceptance criteria: export column pinning + presets, size estimate + thresholds, checksum toggle, accessible heatmap and listbox, and streaming vs background logic. I'll add to ticket.

Rae (Design): thanks team. i'll push updated mock with: pin affordance, estimate display, checksum toggle, patterns on heatmap, and accessible markup examples. Posting v2 in ~2h. :rocket:

Ike (Eng): ping me once v2 is up and i'll attach a small storybook for the listbox and modal behaviors.
